title: 第一卷 第11章 帝子，还请自重！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
就在这电光火石之间，一道剑芒自沐青枫身旁斩过，将他的手臂连同虚空斩碎。

    沐凝薇挣脱束缚，她还没反应过怎么回事，几乎是下意识的扑向了沐云溪。

    与此同时，镇压在沐云溪身上的威压散尽，她一把抱住沐凝薇，生怕她被欺负。

    反观沐青枫，一条手臂在剑芒下化作血雾，发出了撕心裂肺的惨叫。

    几位侍从当即上前，为他送上丹药，止血、疗伤。

    沐青枫咬牙切齿，双目泛红：“我乃靠山王嫡孙，谁敢坏我好事？”

    话音未落，姜无痕在姜临天、姜临渊等一众强者的簇拥下，走进了溪凝苑。

    同时，沐乾钊和苏灵熙同行，他们看向沐青枫的眼神中，满是阴沉。

    “帝君，我……”

    沐青枫什么时候见过这种场面，顿时吓得脸色惨白，整个人僵在了原地。

    “丢人现眼的东西，还不快滚！”

    沐乾钊怒斥道。

    沐青枫如蒙大赦，匆忙离开。

    然而，当他经过姜无痕身边时，后者看了姜临渊一眼。

    下一刻，剑气裹挟着杀意，赫然降临。

    “住手……”

    沐乾钊察觉到时，为时已晚。

    只见姜临渊手中长剑出鞘，一剑将沐青枫和他身边的侍从，尽皆斩杀。

    “姓姜的，你做什么！”苏灵熙不悦，当即质问道，“他做错了事，仙朝律法自会惩戒他，用不着你们狗拿耗子，多管闲事！”

    “仙朝律法？呵，倘若律法严明，他又怎敢光天化日之下，做出这种事？”姜无痕不屑，嗤笑道，“连长公主和郡主的安全都得不到保障，所谓律法……虽不说是形同虚设，却也强不到哪去！”

    “就算如此，那也是太凰仙朝的事情，跟你们有什么关系？”

    苏灵熙沉声道。

    不等姜无痕开口，姜临渊当即反驳道：“怎么没关系？那个畜生要动的……是我们帝子的女人！”

    这时，姜无痕走向沐云溪，脸上露出了令人如沐春风般的微笑：“长公主，还记得我吗？”

    “你是……恒御大帝之子，姜家帝子——姜无痕？”沐云溪打量着他，露出一抹苦笑，“我这般狼狈的模样，让帝子见笑了……”

    姜无痕摇头，伸手握住了沐云溪的小手，后者娇躯一颤，连忙抽回。

    沐凝薇察觉到了他的动作，小脸气鼓鼓的，护在沐云溪身前，眼神警惕。
content_en:
In the midst of the lightning and flint, a ray of sword light slashed past Mu Qingfeng, chopping his arm into pieces along with the void.

    Mu Ningwei broke free from the restraints. Before she could react, she almost subconsciously pounced on Mu Yunxi.

    At the same time, the pressure on Mu Yunxi dissipated, and she hugged Mu Ningwei, fearing that she would be bullied.

    On the other hand, Mu Qingfeng's arm turned into blood mist under the sword light, and he let out a heart-rending scream.

    Several attendants immediately came forward and gave him elixirs to stop the bleeding and heal his injuries.

    Mu Qingfeng gritted her teeth and her eyes turned red: "I am the direct grandson of the patron king, who dares to ruin my good deeds?"

    Before he finished speaking, Jiang Wuhen walked into Xiningyuan surrounded by Jiang Lintian, Jiang Linyuan and other powerful men.

    At the same time, Mu Qianzhao and Su Lingxi were walking together. Their eyes looked at Mu Qingfeng with gloominess.

    "Emperor, I..."

    Mu Qingfeng had never seen such a scene before. She turned pale with fright and froze in place.

    "You're such a disgrace, get out of here!"

    Mu Qianzhao scolded angrily.

    Mu Qingfeng left in a hurry as if she had been granted amnesty.

    However, when he passed by Jiang Wuhen, the latter glanced at Jiang Linyuan.

    The next moment, sword energy came suddenly, carrying murderous intent.

    "Stop..."

    When Mu Qianzhao noticed it, it was too late.

    Jiang Linyuan saw the long sword in his hand unsheathed and killed Mu Qingfeng and his attendants with one strike.

    "Jiang, what are you doing!" Su Lingxi was displeased and immediately asked, "He did something wrong, and the laws of the Immortal Dynasty will punish him. There is no need for you dogs to meddle in other people's business!"

    "The law of the Immortal Dynasty? Oh, if the law is strict, how could he dare to do such a thing in broad daylight?" Jiang Wuhen said with disdain, "The safety of the princess and the princess cannot be guaranteed. The so-called law... although it is not in name only, it is not much stronger!"

    "Even so, it is still a matter of Taihuang Immortal Dynasty. What does it have to do with you?"

    Su Lingxi said in a deep voice.

    Before Jiang Wuhen could speak, Jiang Linyuan immediately retorted: "Why doesn't it matter? That beast wants to touch... is our emperor's son's woman!"

    At this time, Jiang Wuhen walked towards Mu Yunxi with a smile that made people feel like spring breeze: "Princess, do you still remember me?"

    "Are you... Jiang Wuhen, the son of Emperor Hengyu and the emperor of the Jiang family?" Mu Yunxi looked at him and showed a wry smile, "I am so embarrassed that the emperor laughs..."

    Jiang Wuhen shook his head and reached out to hold Mu Yunxi's little hand. The latter's delicate body trembled and he quickly withdrew it.

    Mu Ningwei noticed his movements, her little face was filled with anger, and she stood in front of Mu Yunxi with alert eyes.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 11 Emperor, please respect yourself!
